items.html: You might say, but there is a difference of seven Sefirot of Atzilut between the vessel of Daat and her light, since he stands up in Daat of Atzilut? We must say that even in the Sefirot of Atzilut themselves there is not such a great loss, except when there is a measure of three Sefirot between the light and the vessel without any light at all, not it, and not any other. Yet, here, although her own light rose up, there are still other lights standing at the end of Atzilut, close to Beria, and she can receive illumination from them. She can also receive illumination from her own light through these lights that are close to her. Remember this rule in all the other Sefirot since there are never more than three empty Sefirot of Atzilut between the vessel and the light, and we will never have to return and say this matter in each of them.
